senses.gloss: m.(b. h. עוּל; עול) [that which is carried,] infant, nursling, child (v. עוֹלָל).
units: B. Bath. 9ᵃ sq. ע׳ משגש ארחתיה דאימיה (Ms. H. אילא; Ms. F. עילא; ed. Ven. עיולא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) the suckling that confounded its mother’s way (a surname of R. Ăḥadboy, or of R. Shesheth, v. Rashi a. Tosaf. a. l.)—[pl. עוּלִין foals, v. עִילָא I.]
